mapper.sql: created_on, changed_on, id, name, label, job_template_id, pipeline_id, working_dir, command, overwrite_entrypoint, args, volume_mount, node_selector, resource_memory, resource_cpu, resource_gpu, timeout, retry, outputs, monitoring, expand, created_by_fk, changed_by_fk, skip, resource_rdma, namespace
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.name, t.label, j.name as jobTemplateName, p.name as pipelineName, a.username as creator, DATE_FORMAT(t.changed_on, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as modified, t.expand FROM task t LEFT JOIN job_template j ON t.job_template_id = j.id LEFT JOIN pipeline p ON t.pipeline_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ab_user a ON t.created_by_fk = a.id ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE pipeline_id = #{pipelineId}

SELECT t.created_on, t.changed_on, t.id, t.name, t.label, t.job_template_id, t.pipeline_id, t.working_dir, t.command, t.overwrite_entrypoint, t.args, t.volume_mount, t.node_selector, t.resource_memory, t.resource_cpu, t.resource_gpu, t.timeout, t.retry, t.outputs, t.monitoring, t.expand, t.created_by_fk, t.changed_by_fk, t.skip, t.resource_rdma, t.namespace, a1.nickname as creator, a2.nickname as modifier FROM task t LEFT JOIN ab_user a1 ON t.created_by_fk = a1.id LEFT JOIN ab_user a2 ON t.changed_by_fk = a2.id WHERE t.pipeline_id = #{pipelineId} ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
